card.name: Right before 'OF' in capitalized warnings
card.fires_on: The last word before an expected 'of' in ALL-CAPS label text, such as 'YEARS' before 'OF AGE', 'LOSS-' before 'OF-FUNCTION', or 'INITIATION' before 'OF TREATMENT'.

modes.label: Age phrases
modes.description: A time unit after a number, just before 'OF AGE' in pediatric warnings.
modes.example: HAVE BEEN REPORTED WITH USE OF PROMETHAZINE HYDROCHLORIDE IN PEDIATRIC PATIENTS LESS THAN 2<< YEARS>> OF AGE. A WIDE RANGE OF

modes.label: Noun then OF
modes.description: A noun or word part that is followed by 'OF' in a heading, such as loss-of-function, initiation of treatment, or metabolism of codeine.
modes.example: WARNING: DIMINISHED ANTIPLATELET EFFECT IN PATIENTS WITH TWO LOSS<<->>OF-FUNCTION ALLELES OF THE

card.writes: It boosts odd non-English tokens and suppresses ' of' and its equivalents in other languages, so it works against another 'of' being predicted.
card.plain: It marks the spot in capitalized warning text where the word 'OF' is about to come next.
